question: What decision currently governs rust const checks after the explicit revert? Return the public decision ID and its authority evidence.

claims.text: The decision currently governing this subsystem is rust-lang/rust#154930, which reverted performing basic const checks in typeck (authority evidence: https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/pull/154930).
Decision rust-lang/rust#149375 was reverted because performing basic const checks in typeck caused unintended errors in dead code, with the plan to land it again following a proper types FCP.
